decisions.reason: As a large bulk container very close to the firm’s core reusable-packaging know-how and shown on its own page, it fits the firm’s absorptive capacity well and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.
The bulk-container valve builds directly on existing container engineering and customer applications, so the firm can readily learn from early market use and refine it with its in-house R&D.

The used packaging take-back service is strategically aligned with the shift toward service-based circular packaging, but because it was only mentioned on the website it looks less established and therefore somewhat more at risk than the hardware products.
